aboutGame.title: What is Nayi Naveli?
paragraphs: Nayi Naveli is a 2026 Hindi horror-comedy directed by Balaji Mohan. Yami Gautam leads the story as a picture-perfect new bride who arrives in a chaotic Meerut household and, almost overnight, turns it into something close to paradise.

Her brother-in-law is the only family member who questions the transformation. As the comedy gives way to mystery and supernatural dread, the film asks whether the ideal daughter-in-law is a genuine blessing or an evil force from another world.
